english.title: Contravene instructions made by an officer / constable in order to prevent a flight
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[an officer,]_
(B)_[a constable,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER OR CONSTABLE..), to whom it appeared that an aircraft had intended, or had been likely, to depart for a destination outside the United Kingdom and the Isle of Man from a

english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
contravene instructions
given by an officer / PC
to whom it appears that an aircraft
intended / likely to depart
for a destination outside the UK / Isle of Man
from place other than a customs and excise airport OR
a customs and excise airport
before clearance outwards was given

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
